_note: EXAMPLE protocol only. Thresholds are starting points for the instructor to tune against the lab's own SOP before assessing students.
name: Aseptic syringe transfer (example)

steps.title: Set up in the work zone
steps.instruction: Place vial and syringe inside the marked zone. Keep both hands visible.

rules.message: Show your hands to the camera
Hands must stay inside the aseptic work zone

steps.title: Stabilise the vial
steps.instruction: One hand steadies the vial, the other holds the syringe.

rules.message: Use both hands: one on the vial, one on the syringe
Hand left the aseptic work zone
Hand is shaking. Rest your wrist and steady the vial

steps.title: Draw up the volume
steps.instruction: Draw slowly and smoothly. Keep the syringe steady and upright.

rules.message: Hand left the aseptic work zone
Hold the syringe closer to upright
Hands out of camera view. Step cannot be assessed

steps.title: Expel air bubbles
steps.instruction: Hold the syringe tip-up and steady.

rules.message: Syringe tip must point up while removing air
Hand left the aseptic work zone

steps.title: Dispense into the container
steps.instruction: Move calmly and keep everything inside the zone.

rules.message: Hand left the aseptic work zone
